# KUN4L PvP Pack 16x

A clean and smooth 16x PvP texture pack created by KUN4L for MPvP and CPvP players.

## Features
- Optimized for PvP
- Clean 16x textures
- Better combat visibility
- Lightweight and FPS-friendly
- Smooth gameplay experience

## Supported Modes
- MPvP
- CPvP

Made by KUN4L.
